_comment: vnodes config defaults. Every value here is a snapshot parameter from the blueprint config-schema (captured 2026-07-31). Configurable — never hardcoded in source. Override per-project in .vnodes/config.json or via VNODES_* env vars.

capsule._comment: memory_reserve_tokens is held back from the content budget before pivots spend, because the capsule is assembled for a headless agent and its scarcity is context. Source is the most reproducible thing in the payload — the agent can open the file itself, for free, at any time — while an observation exists nowhere but memory.db and does not rebuild. Measured on this repo 2026-08-23: at an 8000 budget the pivot alone took 7381 tokens, one pivot costing 43x one memory, and all three findings were dropped with no note. The reserve is never larger than the memories actually found, and never more than memory_reserve_max_pct of the budget, so a task with nothing stored costs the content nothing.
capsule._comment_min_clip: min_clip_tokens is the floor below which a pivot that does not fit is given as signatures instead of clipped source. Above it the file is clipped wherever it ranked, because a pivot is a file the graph says the task is about and whether something else outranked it is not a reason to withhold the code. Below it a clip is a scrap — the first few lines of a file say less than its signatures across the whole of it. The first pivot clips regardless: a capsule with no pivot answers nothing.

registry._comment: The knowledge-base registry at $VNODES_HOME/registry, $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/vnodes/registry or ~/.config/vnodes/registry. write_interval_s throttles the snapshot an index run writes; scan_cap bounds the readdir; list_cap bounds the picker's rows; tmp_sweep_s is how long an orphaned atomic-write temp file survives; the two oversize values are where whole-index work (composition, capsule, an unscoped map) is refused with 413 instead of blocking the daemon's only event loop. discover_depth/discover_cap/discover_ms bound the scan (the hub runs it in the background off the listen callback, so the budget is generous: a home directory took 12,810 directories and six seconds on a cold cache, and a scan cut short reports one fewer knowledge base than exists) that finds knowledge bases already on disk: it costs one statSync per directory, and a bound that stops it is always reported rather than looking like a machine with nothing on it.

runtime._comment: Owner build directive 3: switchable dual agentic runtime. provider: 'claude-code' (default, model claude-opus-5) or 'pi' (owner's .pi CLI). pi_model: 'grok-4.5-latest' or 'gpt-5.6-sol'. Flip via config or --runtime/--pi-model flags or VNODES_RUNTIME/VNODES_PI_MODEL env.
